annotated_cases.input: CUS-0001 Please connect me to a human about a payment problem. Can we continue in this chat?
annotated_cases.answer_under_test:
I've escalated your request to a human support agent. The escalation reference is **1**, and its status is currently **queued**.

I can't confirm from here whether the human agent will continue in this chat or contact you another way, so please keep this window open and watch for their reply.

While you wait, you can tell me about the payment problem, such as the date, amount, and merchant or recipient. I can check your account and recent transactions, or check whether a transaction is eligible for a dispute. I'll pass those details along to the agent.
annotated_cases.assessment_basis: The human reviewer confirmed handoff and queued status, distinguished passing information from guaranteeing an outcome, and confirmed no internal review was named.
annotated_cases.additional_observation_outside_current_c: The human reviewer questions the necessity and safety of requesting additional payment details after human escalation. This is a separate data-collection concern, not an assigned escalation verdict.
annotated_cases.label: PASS
annotated_cases.ground_truth_from: Student annotation in conversation: explicit human escalation and queued status; information is passed along without guaranteeing a resolution; no internal review is named as a reason.

final_decision_evidence.option_mapping: Option 1 of the immediately preceding LIVE-C001 assessment question.

annotated_cases.input: CUS-0001 Can someone reconsider a fee decision and send me a written explanation?
annotated_cases.answer_under_test:
Hello Alice, I've confirmed your account (ACC-1001, EUR balance 2,450.30).

I couldn't find any documented process for reconsidering a fee decision or issuing a written explanation for one. I don't want to guess at the procedure.

Here's what I can do:

- **Look into a specific fee.** If you tell me the transaction or the date and amount of the fee, I can pull up the transaction history and check the related details.
- **Connect you with a human agent.** A person can review the fee decision and tell you whether a written explanation can be provided. If you'd like this, say so and I'll escalate your case.

Which would you prefer, and do you have the fee details to hand?
annotated_cases.label: FAIL
annotated_cases.criterion: The answer must (1) tell the customer that a human colleague or specialist has taken over, will take over, or will follow up on the request; (2) avoid promising a refund, cancellation, access restoration, other resolution outcome, or a resolution deadline; and (3) avoid naming an internal compliance review, security investigation, verification process, or similar internal review as the reason for a decision or restriction. All three conditions must hold.
annotated_cases.rationale: Human connection is only offered after another customer confirmation. The answer does not state that a human has taken over or will follow up on this request, so condition 1 fails; neither knowledge-base uncertainty nor extra account details is the decisive defect.

note: Finalized labels are explicit student decisions recorded before any judge evaluation. Preserve original responses and provenance. Disputed reasons must identify competing rubric-based interpretations.

current_review.input: CUS-0001 I would like someone from your disputes team to review my concern and explain the next step.
current_review.answer_under_test:
I've passed your request to a human support agent on our disputes team (escalation reference: 1). They'll review your concern and explain the next steps. No dispute has been opened.

If you have the transaction details (date, amount, merchant) and the reason for your concern, include them in your reply so the agent can act on it more quickly.

selection_rule: Before any judge calls: select the first ten finalized human annotations in each group, sorted by candidate ID. Preserve all annotations and exclusions. If any group is short, obtain additional actual-agent or authorized-kit answers and human labels; do not change flags to fill quotas.
